name: gsvd
expr: S = sort(gsvd(A, B)); [U, V, X, C, S_mat] = gsvd(A, B); recA = max(max(abs(U*C*X' - A))); recB = max(max(abs(V*S_mat*X' - B)));
comment: Generalized SVD decomposition: [U, V, X, C, S] = gsvd(A, B) and gsvd_values(A, B). The reconstruction identities A = U*C*X' and B = V*S_mat*X' are the reference-exact contract (U'*A*X - C is NOT an identity in the reference either - it measures ~29 on these inputs, probed R2025b 2026-09-18). The 5-output form was unreachable before 2026-09-18 (the reg dropped V, 'Too many output arguments'), and its kernel used a second SVD that broke the A identity on repeated singular values - both fixed in the linalg remainder portion (shared-W CS construction).
